Name: Lumisteria VIllagers React To Marriage
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
[b]What is the mod ?[/b]
This mod is a Content Patcher Mod using the Conversation Topic added by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10008]More Conversation Topics[/url]. It has currently lines for Demetrius, Jodi, Kent, Lewis, Marnie, Pam, Pierre, and Robin, with often a variation based on the spouse if it's a relative of one of the mentioned villager.

[b]How do i see the lines ?[/b]
Shortly after the marriage, if the marriage happened when you had More Conversation Topics installed, you'll see the line of dialogue when speaking with the npc as usual. Dialogues are one time only (unless you remarry, in which case they should repeat). Duration of the Conversation Topic can be set in the config of MCT.

[b]What about adding lines for (NPC) ?[/b]
If this is a vanilla NPC i may add it. For custom NPC it is better if it's the mod author that adds the related lines. For vanilla NPC and reaction about being married to a custom NPC, it is the same, better of the mod author adds the related lines :)

[b]Is it canon-friendly ? Is it compatible with other mods ?[/b]
I did my best to be canon friendly, you'll judge. About compatibility : this mod should be compatible with pretty much any mod. However, if another mod try to edit the "wedding" conversation topic, one may overwrite the other. I did my best to include configuration so you can enable or disable specific character. As this mod is pretty simple, any dialogue mod that want to do the same thing can simply add this mod as an optional dependency to ensure that it will overwrite my content. You can also simply add config options as i did.

Note : behaviour with multiple spouse is unknown. It is possible that the villagers will not react to your most recent marriage. It shouldn't have major issues however :)

[b]Can i use this mod as an example ? I want to add lines to the villagers/i want to add the line to my custom npcs.[/b]
Feel free to use it as an example or a template. Please don't reuse the same dialogue however :)[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10008]
[/url]
